top_signals.title: ‘War on wealth creation’: capital gains tax raid would lose government money, Tories argue
top_signals.summary: A fresh capital gains tax raid on Britain’s wealthiest would ultimately lose the government money, according to new Conservative analysis of Treasury data. top_signals.title: Reported cargo theft rises 5% in Q2 as Southern California remains a hot spot
top_signals.summary:
Reported U.S. cargo theft incidents rose 5% in Q2, with California and Texas accounting for more than half of recorded cases. Electronics led targeted commodities, while Southern California remained a major cargo theft hot spot.

top_signals.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
top_signals.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
